sentences.text: Learned counsel argued that the present FIR has been filed simply in order to harass and create undue pressure.
Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application by contending that the applicant has deceived the prosecutrix and so was the submissions by the learned counsel appearing for the complainant.

4. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and upon perusal of the contents of the FIR, this Court is of the prima- facie view that the relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix was that of consent.

That apart, the fact that the pregnancy of the prosecutrix was aborted twice, this Court is of the view that the allegation of commission of rape and offence under Section 313 IPC are not sustainable.

5. In view of the aforesaid, this Court deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused-applicant under Section 439 Cr.P.C.,
who is behind the bars since 08.08.2023.
6. Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
